next.reason: 1985: a control footing is processed at the end of its control group; FINAL's once, as the last body group; on a GENERATE control break the footings of 'the highest level of the control break or more minor levels' are presented; at TERMINATE all of them 'if there has been at least one GENERATE statement executed'. 2023: §2023:13.18.57.4 GR6 e)1 on a break 'in order of controls from the lowest up to the level of the control break' and e)2 at TERMINATE 'provided that at least one GENERATE statement has been executed after the chronologically last INITIATE statement for the report, in order of controls from lowest to highest'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR5 a); §2023:14.9.46.4 GR3 b) 'Each control footing is printed, if defined, beginning with the minor control footing'; §2023:14.9.46.4 GR2 nothing at all without a GENERATE; §2023:13.18.16.4 GR2 FINAL is the highest level, so its footing prints only at TERMINATE, last. 'After the chronologically last INITIATE' is the same interval as §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2. Same behavior.
